questions.stem: A 45 year old man was sitting and eating in a restaurant with his friends. He seemed to be an alcoholic and suddenly he suffocated and collapsed on the floor. On examination, his pulse was strong and his face began to turn blue. He is suddenly rolled into a prone position and with his hands interlocked pressure is exerted against the epigastrium 2-3 times and the food is expelled. What is this manoeuvre called?
